name: [🏍️NEW BIKES] Redlane [BETA]
desc:
🏍️ REDLANE

An endless city expressway, a fast bike, and traffic that won't move for you.

Thread between cars at full speed. The closer you pass, the more you earn. Chain near misses, ride into oncoming traffic, lift the front wheel. Touch a car and the run is over.

USE CODE “AIRBORNE” FOR 50K.

👍 NEXT CODE AT 1000 LIKES

🌆 Endless highway, tunnels and skyline, no finish line
🏁 Ten bikes, from a scooter to a hyperbike
💴 Earn cash on the road, spend it at the dealership
🎁 Daily rewards and quests
👥 Ride alongside other players
🎮 PC, gamepad and mobile

🚧 Early development, so expect bugs. More bikes on the way.

llm.loop: ride a motorbike down an endless traffic highway -> near-miss cars for cash -> crash ends run -> buy better bikes at dealership
llm.objectives: survive as long as possible while chaining near misses for cash
llm.progression: cash, ten bikes from scooter to hyperbike, customization, daily rewards and quests
llm.instructions: thread between cars at speed, chain near misses, ride into oncoming traffic, wheelie; touching a car ends the run
unique: Traffic Rider-style endless lane-splitting in Roblox with realistic visuals
llm.thumbnails: realistic sportbike speeding on city highway with Redlane logo
llm.complexity_notes: procedural endless highway with traffic AI, vehicle physics, multiple bike models; realistic environment
